== Published English Original Virtual Set 5 wording ==
The later slip increases deploy from 2 to 4 and adds Presence. The original separately permits IG-88 to battle and be battled. The later text drops the captive escort defense bonus and four named immunities, adds weapon destiny cancellation for 1 Force, and sets attrition immunity at less than 5. Both keep the inherited Pilot and two Warrior icons, the pilot bonus, two weapons and the captive escort card draw.
